## Goal
Determine whether `parallel=2` improves completed OpenClaw work per wall-clock minute while retaining a 128K-class profile.

## Required baseline
- [ ] C1 / parallel=1
- [ ] C2 / parallel=2
- [ ] C4 exploratory only if safe
- [ ] short workload
- [ ] 8K-32K workload
- [ ] ~64K workload
- [ ] ~118K workload where feasible
- [ ] C1 -> C2 -> C1
- [ ] cancellation isolation

## Evidence
Record BASE SHA, exact config, repetitions, TTFT, aggregate/per-request tok/s, prefill, expert-cache metrics, VRAM/pinned RAM, MTP solo acceptance, tool correctness and full campaign wall time.

## Decision
PROMOTE / DEFER / REJECT

See `docs/RTX5080_OPENCLAW_BENCHMARK.md`.
